title: Development of a Home Test for Measuring Blood P-tau217 in Alzheimer's Disease Using the Tasso Lancet Device
official: Development of a Home Test for Measuring Blood P-tau217 in Alzheimer's Disease Using the Tasso Lancet Device
summary: This study compares p-tau217 concentrations in blood collected via the Tasso device versus standard venipuncture in subjects with and without Alzheimer's disease, including a subset with confirmed amyloid pathology.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* AD Amyloid PET/CSF confirmed, healthy control, or amyloid-negative non-AD cognitive impairment Age 40-90 Able to complete Tasso and venipuncture collection Caregiver consent/assistance available if needed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncontrolled systemic conditions Recent surgery/hospitalization (3 months) Other dementia drug trial (2 months) Pregnancy Prior Donanemab or Lecanemab use
